That's when I realised the restaurant branch automatically changed and it probably removed the item that was not available in the store by itself. This lead to additional delivery charges and when I tried to cancel, that didn't happen and there was no response from support for 15 minutes. ended up paying extra for a glitch on the app.

Worst app ever. Whenever I order from Instamart, the prices are always higher compared to other apps. I’ve literally compared the prices, and the difference is noticeable.On top of that, there was an instance where they didn’t even deliver one of the items I ordered. I complained about it, but I still didn’t receive my refund. This is extremely disappointing and frustrating.Instamart is honestly a waste of money. Very poor service and even worse customer support. I would not recommend this app.

They don’t deliver the food within the time they show. They usually take much longer, and the estimated delivery time isn’t accurate either. For example, if I order something from them, they may show an estimated delivery time of 20–30 minutes, but they actually take more than 45–50 minutes to deliver it.At least give an accurate delivery time instead of giving an unrealistic estimate.

Happened again today. Always when I do prepaid (online pay) orders they scam. The delivery person always says to cancel the order or make some excuses. At last I have to cancel the order and pay for the whole order as a cancellation fee. I have reached out to customer support they just say to do mail. And after that nothing ever happens. I don't want my money back. I want you to take strict actions against these types of delivery persons.

I have been trying to log in to my Swiggy account, but I continuously receive the message: “Too many login attempts detected on this device. Please login from an account used earlier.” I have already contacted Swiggy Support multiple times through email, but unfortunately, I have not received any proper or effective solution. The responses have been repetitive and do not actually resolve the issue. This is extremely frustrating, especially when the problem is clearly related to the device/login

Worst app! Just now, I've ordered from KFC and there was an item missing from the order. So, I contacted the Help desk. Even if they couldn't get my item again, they could've just Refunded my amount for that particular item. Instead, they closed off the conversation. This is the SECOND time happening like this in the LAST ONE MONTH

Swiggy is honestly one of the worst apps I’ve ever used. This has happened to me 3–4 times now. I place an order, it gets confirmed, and the app shows 20–25 minutes for delivery, but even after an hour, the order is still not delivered. The tracking keeps getting stuck on “Delivery Partner will be assigned,” and the partner is often assigned only after an hour.On top of that, cancelling the order is not allowed despite such delays.The service is extremely frustrating and needs improvement.

Just giving 1 star because I can’t give -100 stars. I placed an order and tried to cancel it almost immediately, but the app said, “Your food is being cooked.” Seriously? How is the food already being prepared so quickly after placing the order? On top of that, the app doesn’t let me cancel the order or properly connect with customer support. I don’t want the order anymore, but there’s no proper way to cancel it. And somehow, even in 2026, the app is still the same. It crashes whenever I try

Very poor service and a very disappointing experience. My order was cancelled without my permission, which is completely unacceptable. The delivery partner was not assigned on time, and the delivery partners seem to cancel orders at their own convenience without any proper communication or consideration for the customer. This kind of service is highly unprofessional and unacceptable.

I have been a regular Swiggy customer and have placed most of my food orders through your app. However, after today’s experience, I feel extremely disappointed and honestly feel that Swiggy has lost a valuable customer. My last order was placed automatically even after I had cancelled the payment. Despite this, I was later charged a cancellation fee for an order that I did not intentionally place and did not even consume. What made the experience worse was that I had to wait for almost an hour

Browse the restaurant: "Free Delivery." Hit the payment screen: ₹71 delivery fee magically added, even though the place is under 7 km away. Apparently "free" means something entirely different in your dictionary. As if the hefty markup on every single menu item wasn't enough, you still need to sneak in extra fees right at checkout. The aggressive penny-pinching is almost impressive. If you need the ₹71 that badly, just be honest upfront instead of playing bait-and-switch at the payment gateway.

Recently placed an order in Swiggy and I raised a complaint regarding the order issues. I also sent the details via email. I had ordered a guava mojito, but instead received a completely different item. No action has been taken yet other than an expired coupon. very disappointed in the way the complaint is handled. I have contacted Swiggy almost three times to get this issue registered(before sending emails), but despite my repeated attempts, no proper resolution has been provided.

Very disappointing experience with Swiggy. I placed my order yesterday, but it was delivered 1 hour 25 minutes after placing the order. The food was prepared the delivery agent did not pick up the order for another 40 minute. Because of this unnecessary delay, the food quality had clearly suffered by the time it was delivered. I contacted Swiggy Customer Care four times, but the support team failed to provide any satisfactory solution at all. Extremely poor service and customer support.

I think swiggy's competitors are doing good then swiggy, because first very huge issue faced by not only me but many people is that their delivery partner assigning process is very slow and it's very hard to find delivery partners on this app, like sometimes they take 15 to even 20 mins just to find a delivery partner (happened with me many times), second of all they should add an information page about the restaurants listed on the app to have info like their opening and closing time and stuff

That's when I realised the restaurant branch automatically changed and it probably removed the item that was not available in the store by itself. This led to additional delivery charges and when I tried to cancel, that didn't happen and there was no response from support for 15 minutes. Ended up paying extra money don't use this app

The delivery assignment system is completely broken. Swiggy accepted my payment immediately, but the app has been stuck on "Assigning a delivery partner" for over 50 minutes. They hook you with a quick delivery time, take your money, and then leave you stranded without a rider. To make it worse, the automated chatbot support locks you in a loop and refuses to let you cancel or get a refund. Horrible customer experience.

This app has seemingly infinite ads everywhere, from the time you open it. Even simply having it open to track the order has three seperate ads, not even on the side, it literally minimises the map to show a video ad. If I was using the app for free, I'd have no right to even complain, but I am actually subscribed to One BLCK and they still force me to go through this horrible experience, good service but a horrible bloated app, disgraceful.

Very disappointing experience with Swiggy. I paid for an item, but the item was never delivered. Instead of refunding my money, Swiggy offered me a coupon, which is not an acceptable resolution. I paid for a product, not a coupon. Either deliver the item I paid for or refund the full amount to my original payment method. The amount may be small, but the principle matters. Customers should not be made to bear the loss for an order they never received. Swiggy needs to take responsibility.

1st time spillage item received and for 2nd order, did not receive full order and Swiggy is not taking any responsibility and just saying to give review for the restaurant. Delivery time shows 35 minutes and after 1 hour they don't deliver the food. also, in bolt it shows 10-15 minutes, but the same issue occurs. 1 star is too much for this app.

I was scrolling through options when i accidentally clicked on payment, when i came back it showed me two options that weren't descriptive enough and i naively selected the one that somehow directly places your order, upon realising my mistake within a minute i tried to cancel my order but guess what. The chatbot won't let me cancel the order I placed saying the restaurant has prepared my order but on their app they are showing the rider will pick it up in 30 mins..worst customer support

i ordered a cake the prize was a bit high but it was fine.Then I ordered it, and the money was deducted from my account, but the order still wasn’t placed. I tried ordering it a second time, and the same thing happened. when I ordered it for the third time, the order went through. It showed an estimated delivery time of 35 minutes, but it actually arrived after an hour, and on top of that, it was damaged. I wanted to give it a -5 but the option was not available, i am very disappointed...

If the 99 Store is not actually a single store and each restaurant has its own separate cart/order system, then why is it being presented as a 99 Store? Users naturally assume that they can browse different foods within the ₹99 Store and add their preferred items to the same cart. However, when they select a second item, they are asked to remove the first one. I wanted to order more items too, but there’s no point. I’d rather just uninstall this app, because you people are simply fooling users.

Whenever I order food, it takes a really long time to arrive. They initially say it will take 20–30 minutes, but even after an hour, I’m still waiting for the order. Also, the delivery person who came this time was not a Tamil speaker, so we couldn’t properly explain the location in Hindi and guide him to the exact place. I had already provided the correct and exact location, and all the previous delivery partners were able to reach the location without any problem.

There's a nice scam going on. Initially they'll try to show you all the coupons possible, then as u become a regular customer, they'll not show even available coupons. If you have enough time to check, good for you, but what if you want to do price comparisons quickly? Secondly, their map is terrible, pathetic. Try to zoom in, it keeps zooming out and it annoys the hell out of me. Even AI can probably make a better app.

I am just giving 1 star because I can't give -100 stars to write the feedback. the application is not working when I'm trying to chat with customer support team. I can't cancel my order anyhow and I don't want it to be delivered because it has taken 50 minutes till now and hasn't reached me while it showed the maximum delivery time of 30 minutes. the service sucks! Update: Even in 2026, the app is still the same. It crashes whenever I try to track my order. Pathetic!

Swiggy simply decided to jump on the AI bandwagon, without thinking it through. In a normal scenario, you simply cannot reach the customer support executive, the AI simply doesn't allow it. The delivery guy took a long time, just to pickup the order because he was busy doing I do not know what...could see him on the map not even trying to pick up the order. Team, think things through before taking the AI route and the process for it. Kudos to your team, if u think this will lead to more busines

Worst service ever. I placed my order more than 1 hours before reaching the station, and it remained "Confirmed," but it was never delivered. I kept calling customer support, and they repeatedly assured me it would arrive, but no one contacted me or delivered the order. I had already paid via UPI, and now my payment is also stuck. I was travelling with my family, which made the situation even more frustrating. Very disappointing service. Please don't rely on this app for train food deliveries

The entire Swiggy network is scam. I ordered food from a local shop and the quantity was too insufficient for the amount I paid. When I asked for a refund, they told me only a coupon will be provided. Why the hell are you receiving the payment in cash and refunding in coupon? Horrible service. No more ordering from this App. Absolute gold diggers.

Ordering takes longer, and delivery takes even longer, even though my house is very close and only takes five minutes to reach. Sometimes they refuse to come to my door, and sometimes the order arrives incomplete; for example, with mayonnaise, I order two and they only bring one, even though I paid for two.

Swiggy needs to update the App. I saw Crispy Belly Pork listed in one of the restaurants but when I tried to find the item again I ended up with a list of random restaurants that do not sell the dish. I ended up visiting one restaurant which actually sells that dish. Which is inconvenient. Swiggy should add a "Dishes" like Zomato tab so that customers can find the dish they want quickly. This will increase sales. Please take this suggestion seriously. Hoping for an updated App soon.

The “Proceed Order Anyway” option after a payment failure/cancellation is concerning. My young son accidentally clicked it, and the order was placed immediately without any OTP or confirmation. Unfortunately, such orders cannot be cancelled either. Please reconsider this option and add a confirmation/OTP step to prevent accidental orders, especially by children. This would make the ordering experience much safer for customers.

This app seriously needs to be fixed. Many times, I enter and save my address correctly, and it is shown correctly on the Swiggy page too. However, the delivery partner somehow receives a completely different/random address. This creates unnecessary confusion and makes them struggle to find my location, while I have to guide them over calls. Please look into this issue and ensure that delivery partners receive the exact same address shown on the app.

I was shown a cashback offer while shopping on the app, but I never received the cashback. When I raised a complaint, the app team said it was a third-party issue and asked me to contact the payment gateway. This is disappointing—if the offer is shown on your app, you should take responsibility for resolving the issue instead of passing the customer to another party.

Swiggy is stealing money from people through policies that are nothing but scam. If your order is not delivered, instead of refunding the money (which is bare minimum they should do), they issue you a coupon that is valid for a week, so that if you don't order again, they can keep your money. That coupon can not be used to replace the missing items from your order as well because they put several restrictions on these coupons ensuring you can't use them. Stay away from these scamsters.

For the last 2–4 months, this app has been repeatedly misleading by showing an estimated delivery time of just 25–30 minutes and once the order is placed, the delivery gets delayed to 1–1.5 hours, while the app keeps showing the same useless message: "Delivery partner is being assigned." What's even more frustrating is that if I decide to cancel the order because of their failure to deliver on time, I'm the one who gets penalized. Why should customers pay for the platform's poor service.

This was my 1st order on Swiggy and it was a terrible experience. I placed an order and realized I selected the wrong item. I cancelled it within 2 minutes of payment. Swiggy deducted the FULL order amount as "cancellation charges" and did NOT refund even 1 rupee. I immediately called customer service and asked if they could deliver instead of cancelling, but they ignored my request. Taking 100% of the amount from a new user for a 2-min cancellation feels like theft, not a policy.

Swiggy's delivery service is absolutely pathetic. My order took 1 hour and 29 minutes to arrive, which is completely unacceptable. I complained through the app, and all they did was assign another delivery partner. After that, the app kept showing "11 minutes away" for ages and even promised that my order would arrive in 25 minutes, but it never did. Stop misleading customers with fake ETAs and fix your broken delivery system. This is beyond frustrating and a complete waste of my time. I expecte

Swiggy is a fantastic app with excellent service and I enjoy using it. I would appreciate it if you could introduce more customer-friendly features, such as free delivery on orders above ₹49, extending the free delivery distance to 10 km, and adding a low-to-high price sorting option for products. These enhancements would make the app even more convenient, affordable, and encourage customers to place orders more frequently. I hope you will consider these suggestions. Thank you.

I have been using instamart for the last 4 months and initially everything was good. But since the last 2 weeks, the offers and policies have completely changed. Free delevary condition has been increased from 99 to 199. Lots of promotional offers on minimum purchase are also removed. Instamart should understand that it is't that we could not go to shop directly and buy items. It's just a matter of convenience only we tried this online platform. But sadly new policies arnt customer friendly.

This was one of the worst customer service experiences I've had. I accidentally placed an order and canceled it within one minute, yet Swiggy refused to cancel it. How is it fair to deny a cancellation request made almost immediately? It feels like Swiggy cares more about charging customers than providing genuine support. There should be at least a few minutes' grace period for accidental orders. Instead, I was left with no help, no flexibility, and no concern for the customer.

I'm was a regular customer of Swiggy but nowadays Extremely frustrated with Swiggy's deceptive delivery timelines. When ordering, the app promises a reasonable 35-minute delivery. However, once payment is made, they repeatedly delay the timer. After waiting for 70 to 80 minutes, customer support simply asks you to cancel the order if you can't wait longer. It is a massive waste of time and a terrible user experience. Avoid if you are actually hungry. Finally unstalled the app.

Very disappointing experience with Instamart. My order is showing as “Delivered” in the app, but I have not received the order at all. I checked properly, but there was no delivery made to me. It is unacceptable to mark an order as delivered when the customer has not actually received it. I request Instamart to investigate this issue immediately and provide either my order or a full refund. Please improve the delivery verification process so customers do not have to face such situations.

Swiggy has now become the worst delivery app now. They charge so many different kinds of additional charges. and then deliver the order with missing items. When asked for replacement, they say only refund is possible. So if you need to order again you will need to pay the additional fees all over again. They want you to subscribe to Swiggy Black. So now other orders get delayed by more than an hour sometimes. Swiggy is a company that is cheating consumers everyday.

Very bad experience. I have been using Swiggy for more than 8 years. There had been times when I faced issues but they were resolved. Today, however, the customer support wasn't very willing to help and even disconnected the call. My order is still stuck and this time I am not even going to do anything about it. I will see for how long you guys will keep an order active. I am definitely switching after this.

Instamart missed an item in my order and refunded only the item's cost. Because of their mistake, I now have to place another order and pay delivery, platform, and other charges again. The app has no proper way to escalate complaints, and customer care simply said they couldn't help. Many users have reported similar issues with missing items and poor support. Very disappointing service and no accountability.

Very disappointing experience! I ordered a meal but received something completely different. On top of that, I used my coupon code on this order, and when I asked for it back due to their mistake, they clearly refused. This is not acceptable at all. If the fault is from your side, customers should not have to suffer the loss. Extremely poor customer service and zero accountability. Not ordering again!

I've placed a chicken burger in the order but it has taken something else than the item that I've ordered and then when I want to cancel the order, it repeatedly says you can't cancel the order as it is being prepared and also when I insisted for cancellation they charged the whole amount paid for the order as cancellation fees. There are too many scams happening at the moment and I can't be able to trust this platform anymore.

It's been an hour since I placed the order on Swiggy, but my pizza still hasn't arrived. On top of that, the delivery is taking so long.I'm getting really irritated with Swiggy because my order still hasn't arrived. It's been showing "7-8 minutes" for so long, but the delivery isn't moving. Their delivery is extremely slow and the service is really disappointing. It's taking way too much time. Swiggy's delivery is really slow. Zepto's delivery service is much better than theirs.

I had a very disappointing experience with Swiggy Instamart. I ordered a few items, including ice cream, but the delivery executive took almost 1 hour to deliver the order. By the time I received it, the ice cream had completely melted and was no longer in proper condition. I understand that delays can sometimes happen, but taking an hour to deliver an order containing frozen items is unacceptable. Swiggy should ensure that frozen products are handled and delivered within a reasonable time.

Horrible Experience 😡 Tried ordering a food using an Axis Credit Card offer 💳. The payment failed, the offer wasn't applied, but unbelievably, the order was still placed! I contacted customer support and the restaurant, but neither could cancel the order. I finally accepted the delivery only because I didn't want the delivery partner to suffer because of the app's failure. A completely frustrating experience. Very poor payment, offer and cancellation system. 👎😡 AI responses may include

They are frequently giving one item short, and as a refund they will provide coupon, and keep a time limit for that. Why should there be a time limit on my refund money, and even if I want to use that, I will again have to order by giving all the extra delivery charge, platform fee, surge fee, packing charge etc. Also I cannot club another coupon with my refund as if the refund is some kind of discount offer from swiggy.

Getting very worst experience, I am using this app more than 5 years. However, today I have getting very much disappointed service from Swiggy. They deliver the food almost double time, when I order delivery time shown as 40-50 minutes, but actual foods received after 75 minutes. However, I have requested to canceled it after 20 minutes, since status shown as food is still preparing and taken more 50 minutes. But they tries to force me don't cancel it otherwise you have to pay penalty 3 times.

No customer support. I was urgently trying to get in touch with a customer support agent only to find out that they don't even have the option. Further to this review, I am now experiencing another irritating problem. I pressed on the scenes section of the app and it is not allowing me to go to the main app without selecting 3 scenes choices. As usual, I am going to get a robotic response asking to write an Email.

Worst experince. They neither delivered order, nor canceled it. There was no cancellation option also. After chatting with their bot, order got canceled without any refund. Their customer care are we can not do anything. After, multiple mails asking for details, they said read the Policy, we cannot refund without any justification. I wrote multiple emails and on reply they gave a generic statement.

Ordered McDonald's worth ₹950 for my colleagues and me. Multiple items were missing, including fries and an Apple Pie. We only received burgers and drinks. Reported the issue immediately through the help section, but no proper resolution was provided. Mistakes can happen, but poor customer support is unacceptable. Very disappointed with how this issue was handled.

very very very bad experience in Swiggy... I ordered a pizza on Swiggy, but I accidentally placed the wrong order and now I want to cancel it because I actually wanted to order something else. However, there is no cancellation option available, and I’m unable to cancel the order. I tried calling the restaurant, but their phone is switched off. I also messaged the assistant through the app, but they said the order cannot be cancelled and that I’ll have to pay the full amount, with no cancellatio

This app is in the 90's. I place an order and usually it takes 20 minutes. I order from this restaurant frequently today it was showing more than an hour. so I requested to cancel my order but Swiggy's support team says it's Swiggy's limitation. we can't refund. seriously? This is the worst thing. Swiggy or restaurant to failed to fulfill their services and why I will have to pay?

The bot is useless. I ordered more than an hour ago and the order has not reached me yet(was supposed to get it in 30 mins)and I can't cancel the order cuz you charge the cancellation fee when I'm not at fault. 'keep waiting for 5 mins' is all that your ai bot keeps saying. the delivery agent is not moving and won't answer calls. Not using this app again. other food delivery apps do resolve issues very quick. Look into it. And when we post review you ask us to mail it instead of solving. USELESS

I have been using Swiggy for the past 5 years and have ordered many times through the app. However, nowadays the offers and discounts are very limited compared to earlier. Because of this, many food orders are no longer worth the price. As a long-time customer, I request Swiggy to provide better offers and discounts for regular and loyal customers. This would encourage us to continue ordering through Swiggy.

Absolutely hated the experience of swiggy. -1/10 not recommend to anyone at all. Dont use this app if you want to save your mental peace. From past 50 minutes they made me wait for an order which was getting reassigned to multiple delivery partners and at the end just getting cancelled without any prior notice!! I mean, stop taking your customers for a joke! You need to do better!

Swiggy is finding Innovative ways to extract money from customers. Their latest is platform fees. This is another level scam selling customers swiggy super advertising no extra cost on orders. Then introducing new added costs in bill such as "platform fees". Swiggy super now reduced the free delivery to 7km. there is no point in buying Swiggy super. it's worth less.

Worst app and worst delivery experience. The app showed a delivery time of 35 minutes, so I placed the order at 8:30 PM. It is now 10:20 PM and my food still hasn’t arrived. No one is answering calls, there is no proper redressal, and even the customer care person disconnected the call without giving any answer. Extremely disappointing and unprofessional service. Would not recommend this app.

It is widely considered as a nice food ordering platform. But some things definitely make it bad. First of all, it takes so much time to deliver the food. Who would like to wait for 1 hour ? Secondly, it includes so many extra and additional charges on the name of government tax. Nobody would like to give unnecessary charges. Very disappointed

Very unsatisfactory experience, I paid 1600 rupees for my order which was immediately deducted from my payment application and bank but due to Swiggy's payment syncing problem the customer support kept calling and telling me that the payment has not been done either I have to do the payment again or have to return my order for which I had paid the whole amount already and provided no solution when I told to check the transaction id or either initiate refund for my order. Worst experience ever.

I purchased items today from Swiggy Instamart. It got divided into two parts so I cancelled the second order Dettol immediately within 2 minutes as delivery timing was 25 minutes & I needed it urgently. They charged me 100% cancellation charges. According to the Help desk this is their policy. Very wrong as order was not even packed and still you charge me 100% cancellation. I'm a regular customer but this is completely cheating. I'm never going to purchase anything if I'm not getting a refund

I have ordered 2 items and one is missing. Delivery guy also confirmed that it's a mistake from hotel and he also raised a ticket. Still Swiggy won't acknowledge their issue... Make me send picture of it again and again and giving me a coupon that will expire in 7 days. not even ready to refund to original payment. now Swiggy will be my last option. i was using Instamart for lot of orders now have to move to blinkit zepto, bb etc...

Rating: ⭐☆☆☆☆Title: Terrible delivery experience and no supportReview: Total waste of time and money. My order was delayed by over an hour, and when it finally arrived, the food was completely cold and leaking inside the bag. Trying to get help from the in-app chat support is a nightmare—you just get automated bot responses that offer no real solution or refund. Very disappointed.

Terrible delivery service and experience. I ordered by mistake and tried to cancel immediately, but the system wouldn't let me. When the driver arrived, they pressured me into accepting the package anyway because of their own request. It is incredibly frustrating and irritating that you cannot cancel an order.

I had an issue with the cancellation fee. I mailed them regarding that and they immediately initiated the refund process unlike other corporates who play annoying games with its customers. Truly a game changing customer service and it is excellent. One request to Swiggy, please don't add Swiggy one subscription to the cart automatically.

Most of the time the order is delayed. While placing order the app shows certain amount of time and once the order is placed, the delivery time is increased. There is no compensation for delayed orders. One more feather in tye cap - Money looters and pathetic customer support 7 years and still nothing has changed. Still late deliver. Cold food served. No responsibility

One of the worst service experiences. They have repeatedly sent wrong items, & despite the mistake being entirely on their side, the customer has to waste time and money dealing with their complicated refund and return process. Their staff also keep quoting unnecessary rules instead of resolving the issue properly. Very disappointing service & customer support. I would strongly recommend looking for a better alternative or simply buying from a nearby shop. There are plenty of options available.

worst App, Delivery time keeps on adding. They show 15-20 mins for grocery delivery but ends up taking more than 40 mins. Same for the food delivery. Try to go and buy on your if possible or via some apps but please try avoiding this useless apps as you'll get at the end of the day is delay and frustration as even after so many complaints they do not try to improve their systems.

Swiggy's gotten terrible in recent times. Three orders cancelled in last 15 days, two of them Instamart orders. Once they accepted an order and informed me 30 minutes later that order was cancelled since there was an issue with the restaurant. All the recent reviews of Swiggy are also giving it one star, indicating that the service has gone downhill like a rollercoaster.

I was just checking out and was going to pay using another account, but by mistake the payment went through LazyPay. I immediately tried to cancel the order, but I’m being charged the full cancellation amount. This is completely unfair and feels like cheating. Since I tried to cancel the order immediately, please consider the situation and provide a full refund without any cancellation charges

Swiggy always fetches my delivery location incorrectly; it usually places the pin on a nearby block. I have never faced this issue with any other delivery app-be it Zomato, Amazon, Blinkit, or Zepto. I have observed this issue across two different states. Please fix your location services, as this causes a great deal of inconvenience for both delivery partners and customers. Otherwise, this is a great app.

This is one of the worst apps when it comes to payment security. Why does the app automatically enter the OTP when I’m making a credit card payment? The whole purpose of an OTP is to provide an extra layer of security and confirmation. I was simply adding an item to my cart, and somehow the payment process was triggered. The OTP was automatically entered without giving me a chance to review or confirm the purchase, and the order was placed for an item I didn’t even intend to buy.

one of the worst apps and food delivery partner. Better to go and bring your own food rather than ordering from swiggy. The food is never delivered on time. Delivery partner is not assigned on time. They don't care about the food which is getting wasted or making it worthless to eat. Customer care service is so poor that if want any solution regarding your order or if you want to cancel the order then they have only 2-3 messages that are shown. No one is taking the calls on customer care

I ordered from Swiggy. I have ordered the same product from this restaurant previously, and it usually came in a plastic box with the restaurant’s name printed on it. This time, the packaging was completely different and did not have the restaurant name, which made me doubt whether the correct item was delivered. Very disappointing experience. Please improve packaging verification and quality checks.

Swiggy’s delivery-time representation appears to be misleading and potentially unfair to customers. The platform sometimes displays a significantly shorter estimated delivery time before the order is placed, but immediately after the order is confirmed, the estimated delivery time may increase substantially—sometimes nearly doubling. initially it was the best app there, but now I'm not satisfied with them, my daughter by mistake placed an order and j went on cancelling it, just 3 sec after placing it, no matter how much i tried they didn't cancel it, kept saying it will go to waste even when my order is not even prepared or not even started preparing, and i end up receiving tones of food, for just one person, and it did go to waste eventually. it's very disturbing and unprofessional, plus they also don't do refunds now.

Extremely disappointing customer service. My order was incomplete, and despite contacting customer support multiple times, I have not received any proper resolution.
